content: मोघ {%a.%} [मुह्-घ अच् वा कुत्वम्] .²1 Vain, useless, fruitless, unprofitable, unsuccessful; याच्ञा मोघा वरमधिगुणे नाधमे लब्धकामा <ls>Me. 6</ls>; मोघवृत्ति कलभस्य चेष्टितम् <ls>R. 11. 39</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 65</ls>; मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः <ls>Bg. 9 12</ls>. .²2 Aimless, purposeless, indefinite. .²3 Left, abandoned. .²4 Idle. .{@-घः@} A fence, an enclosure, a hedge. .{@-घा@} The trumpet flower. .{@-घम्@} {%ind.%} In vain, to no purpose, uselessly.
